label: 南纪门
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. T7 image-to-3D concept asset. One isolated object/module centered, full object visible with generous white margin, PURE SOLID WHITE background, soft even diffuse light, NO cast ground shadow or ambient shadow patch, NO ground plane or scenic base. Stylized LOW-POLY geometry, simplified planar forms, hand-painted texture feel, Ming dynasty architecture. Match style_master ONLY for muted ochre brick, slate-blue roof, grey-green foliage, red-brown columns, ivory walls and restrained ink/watercolor material feel. This is a model-ready object concept, not a paper map or photorealistic building. No text, labels, Chinese characters, numbers, watermark, people, presentation frame or multiple views on a single sheet. Requested 1536x1536 square. For masonry and buildings, absolutely NO incidental vegetation, shrubs, trees, moss, grass, decorative rocks or scenery unless explicitly part of asset. Avoid photographic realism and excessive surface microdetail. Asset J04 (南纪门). Jingzhou Nanji gate complex: main gate platform and separate arrow-tower platform aligned on one straight front-back axis; side doors to left and right create a CROSS-shaped circulation through the barbican passage. Modest wooden gate hall with grey-blue tiled roof on main platform, grey-brick crenellated outer platform. No city, water or terrain. MAIN VIEW: front-right three-quarter camera, 45-degree downward elevation, one object fully visible.
